messages:
marco: quick summary from the pegasus-12b smoke + econ run (int6 vs int4-slim). TL;DR: int6 is a safe win for short-form; int4-slim gives bigger cost wins but has notable longform regressions and a p95 tail that needs kernel work.

zhen: can you paste the key numbers real quick? product needs a one-line cost vs quality stat for GTN.

marco: numbers (mixed production sample, median prompt 54 tok):
- int8 baseline: p50 115ms, p95 320ms, unit cost $0.014/token-eq
- int6: p50 128ms, p95 350ms, unit cost $0.0090/token-eq (~36% cheaper)
- int4-slim: p50 145ms, p95 480ms, unit cost $0.0062/token-eq (~56% cheaper)
quality quick check (GTN slices, n~7.8k):
- short QA EM: int8 80.7%, int6 79.8% (-0.9 pts), int4-slim 77.1% (-3.6 pts)
- rerank proxy NDCG: int8 0.729, int6 0.726 (-0.4%), int4 0.712 (-2.3%)
- long summaries ROUGE proxy: int8 0.64, int6 0.60 (-6 pts), int4 0.51 (-20 pts)
CI: short slices tight (CI ~0.4 pts), longform high variance (n~1.0k)

claire: sounds inline with other runs. product asks: recommendation for default + a short rollout plan to show GTN.

marco: recommended conservative routing snippet: 
```
routes:
  - name: short-default
    match: intent in ["search_snippet","rerank","qa_short"]
    split: { int6: 0.8, int4-slim: 0.1, int8: 0.1 }
  - name: conversation
    match: intent in ["assistant_chat","user_session"]
    split: { int6: 0.6, int8: 0.4 }
  - name: longform
    match: intent in ["summarize_long","doc_analysis"]
    split: { int8: 1.0 }
canary: 1% -> 5% -> 25% with automated QA_EM & latency_p95 checks. rollbacks if QA_EM drop > 1.2 pts or hallucination_rate +0.8% abs.
```

tom: ops question: p95 jump for int4-slim is big. kernel reason?

marco: yes, int4-slim uses an experimental packed-gemm path that sometimes falls back to a slower float path for certain width combos. ops tuning (batch shapes + enable fused-attn) should reduce p95 by ~80-120ms in microbench. open ticket recommended.

ops-bot: canary deployment started for route "short-default" -> 1% at 1705555521 :rotating_light:

zhen: can you also draft a one-paragraph GTN blurb and an example $ calc for a 30M tok/mo customer?

marco: draft blurb: "Recommend making pegasus-12b int6 the default for short-form and rerank traffic. Expected token-unit cost reduction ~36% vs current int8 baseline with minor short-form quality deltas (<1pt EM). Longform remains on int8 until kernel fixes and expanded evals complete. Canary + per-slice rollbacks required."

marco: savings example: 30M tok/mo with 70% eligible -> 21M * (0.014 - 0.009) = $105k/mo gross; realistic realized ~60% -> ~$63k/mo. include note about billed token-eq and priming variance.

claire: ok, please post GTN note and attach per-slice CSVs. ops to open kernel ticket for int4 tail. tom to own p95 tuning. thanks all :thumbsup:
